analysis: The host reported a timeout after an allocation of 1,572.02 GPU-seconds, with no validation score or error details. This trial therefore provides no evidence that interaction features improve or reduce HR@10 relative to the historical 0.5513 macro baseline. The script budgets training over eight hours internally, so its deadlines do not accommodate the reported host allocation. Candidate-conditioned attention, chunk recomputation, and the wider scorer may increase runtime, but the timeout’s precise cause and training progress are unknown. Checkpoint export and scorer verification are present in the code; their successful execution was not reported.
code_summary: One independently trained RecurrentMemory network per category, with all four dataset routes preserved. Each network uses 96-dimensional item embeddings, a causal GRU, candidate-conditioned attention over history, and an MLP scoring concatenated context, sequential state, candidate embedding, and two elementwise candidate interaction features (5 × hidden input). A jointly trained item bias completes the score. Training retains 32 sampled negatives, sampled-softmax plus 0.2-weighted auxiliary BCE, temporal weighting, random prefixes, AdamW, and validation checkpoint selection. The predictor writer exports the shared architecture and strictly loads exactly one selected checkpoint per category; no ensembles or separately fitted scores are used.
